scientific_integrity: The all-parameter formula is proved by a structural upper-bound argument and explicit lower-bound trees; finite recursive computations are consistency checks, not a proof of the infinite range.
scientific_limitations: Only open-neighborhood concepts of J(n,2) for n>=2. Closed neighborhoods, higher Johnson levels and agnostic learning are not covered. Originality is compared against inspected sources, not certified against all publications. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Exact Littlestone dimension of triangular-graph open neighborhoods
